Guidance & outlook: It's an absolute pleasure from ICICI Securities to host the Q1 FY27 earnings call for Jyothy Labs.
For FY27, excluding the Pril business, we expect double -digit revenue growth.
We remain confident of a recovery trajectory and expect the segment to deliver stronger performance in the coming quarters.
Growth & demand: We are, therefore, cautiously optimistic o n the demand with growth expected to be driven by a balanced combination of volume expansion, selective pricing, premiumization and new product scale - up rather than the price increases alone.
Fabric Care maintained its strong momentum, delivering over 14% value growth and 10% volume growth during the quarter.
Excluding Pril and FA, revenue grew by 8.1% in value terms and 5.3% in volume terms on a year -on-year basis.
Margins & costs: Gross margin stood at 38.5%, down by 950 basis points year -on-year, impacted by abnormally high input c ost inflation and lower realizations.
EBITDA margin stood at 8.4%, down about 820 basis points year -on-year, which is flowing through the gr oss margin.

Having said that, the sharp margin contraction witnessed in quarter 1, primarily it is related to the impact of raw material inflation flowing through the P&L, while pricing actions are still catching up with input costs.
Capex & expansion: However, the newly launched bioenzyme -based Exo Liquid has made encouraging progress despite being at an early stage of scale -up and channel expansion.

Our priorities for FY27 are clear: scale recent NPDs, maintain a strong innovation pipeline, improve general trade productivity, sustain volume growth despite price increases, and invest in brands in a calibrated manner.

As far as quick commerce and e -commerce, et cetera is conc erned, both these channels continue to be amongst our fastest -growing channels, as Jyothy mentioned in her opening, and they are becoming increasingly important for category development, consumer acquisition and premium product adoption.
Balance sheet & cash: As commodity prices stabilize and volumes improve, operating leverage should support margin recovery over the coming quarters.
My second question is that we have seen an improvement in the working capital space.
We know that Jyothy is like one of the best you have one of the best working capitals in the industry.
Risks & challenges: Personal Care performance remained subdued during the quarter, impacted by price increases and transient supply chain disruptions.
Inflation, commodity volatility, and heightened competition are likely to keep operating conditions challenging over the next couple of quarters.
Of course, quarter 1 is slightly subdued because of the pent -up demand, et cetera, and also substantial price increases that we have taken 10%.
